description.zh:
地址池集合切换策略：

- AUTO： 自动切换
- DEFAULT：主地址池集合
- FAILOVER： 备地址池集合
description.en:
The switchover policy for the address pool collection:

- AUTO: Automatic switchover

- DEFAULT: Primary address pool collection

- FAILOVER: Failover address pool collection

description.zh: 主地址池集合。
description.en: The primary address pool collection.

description.zh: 主地址池集合列表中地址池id。
description.en: The ID of the address pool in the primary address pool collection.

description.zh: 主地址池集合列表中权重。
description.en: The weight of the address pool in the primary address pool collection.

description.zh:
主地址池类型：

- IPV4
- IPV6
- DOMAIN（域名）
description.en:
The type of the primary address pool:

- IPV4

- IPV6

- DOMAIN

description.zh:
主地址池集合延时解析调度优化：

- OPEN：开启
- CLOSE：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable latency-based scheduling for the primary address pool collection:

- OPEN: Enabled

- CLOSE: Disabled

description.zh:
主地址池集合均衡策略：

- ALL_RR: 返回全部地址
- RATIO：按权重返回地址
description.en:
The load balancing policy for the primary address pool collection:

- ALL\_RR: Returns all addresses.

- RATIO: Returns addresses by weight.

description.zh: 主地址池集合最多返回地址数量。
description.en: The maximum number of addresses returned from the primary address pool collection.

description.zh: 主地址池集合最小可用地址数量。
description.en: The minimum number of available addresses in the primary address pool collection.

description.zh: 备地址池集合，若未设置备地址池集合，输入"EMPTY"。
description.en: The failover address pool collection. If no failover address pool collection is configured, enter "EMPTY".

description.zh: 备地址池集合列表中地址池id。
description.en: The ID of the address pool in the failover address pool collection.

description.zh: 备地址池集合列表中权重。
description.en: The weight of the address pool in the failover address pool collection.

description.zh:
备地址池类型：

- IPV4
- IPV6
- DOMAIN
description.en:
The type of the failover address pool:

- IPV4

- IPV6

- DOMAIN

description.zh:
备地址池集合延时解析调度优化：

- OPEN：开启
- CLOSE：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable latency-based scheduling for the failover address pool collection:

- OPEN: Enabled

- CLOSE: Disabled

description.zh:
备地址池集合均衡策略：

- ALL_RR: 返回全部地址
- RATIO：按权重返回地址
description.en:
The load balancing policy for the failover address pool collection:

- ALL\_RR: Returns all addresses.

- RATIO: Returns addresses by weight.

description.zh: 备地址池集合最多返回地址数量。
description.en: The maximum number of addresses returned from the failover address pool collection.

description.zh: 备地址池集合最小可用地址数量。
description.en: The minimum number of available addresses in the failover address pool collection.

description.zh: 部分返回参数语言。默认值：en。取值范围：en、zh、ja。
description.en: The language of the response. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

description.zh: 访问区域LineCode列表。例如：`["default", "drpeng"]`，即全局策略和鹏博士。
description.en: The line codes of the access regions. For example, `["default", "drpeng"]` specifies the global line and the Dr. Peng line.

description.zh: 策略id。可通过调用[DescribeDnsGtmAccessStrategies ](~~2357191~~)获取。
description.en: The ID of the policy. To obtain the policy ID, call [DescribeDnsGtmAccessStrategies](~~2357191~~).

description.zh: 策略名称。
description.en: The name of the policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-dns-gtm-access-strategy --lang en --strategy-id hrb00 --strategy-name test --lines default_,_drpeng --default-addr-pool-type IPV4 --default-lba-strategy ALL_RR --default-min-available-addr-num 1 --default-max-return-addr-num 1 --default-latency-optimization OPEN --failover-addr-pool-type IPV4 --failover-lba-strategy ALL_RR --failover-min-available-addr-num 1 --failover-max-return-addr-num 1 --failover-latency-optimization OPEN --default-addr-pool LbaWeight=1 Id=po000 --failover-addr-pool LbaWeight=1 Id=po00 --access-mode DEFAULT --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UpdateDnsGtmAccessStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --FailoverMinAvailableAddrNum 1 --FailoverAddrPool.1.LbaWeight 1 --DefaultAddrPoolType IPV4 --FailoverAddrPoolType IPV4 --DefaultLatencyOptimization OPEN --FailoverAddrPool.1.Id po00 --StrategyId hrb00 --Lang en --DefaultAddrPool.1.LbaWeight 1 --DefaultMinAvailableAddrNum 1 --FailoverLatencyOptimization OPEN --StrategyName test --FailoverLbaStrategy ALL_RR --FailoverMaxReturnAddrNum 1 --DefaultMaxReturnAddrNum 1 --AccessMode DEFAULT --DefaultAddrPool.1.Id po000 --DefaultLbaStrategy ALL_RR --Lines 'default_,_drpeng'
